about: Stress-test findings for the investigation agent. Each has the expected outcome. 'type:savings' means every product of that type. Treat historical figures as illustrations, not facts.

must_screen_out.why: weaker rupee raises LKR gold value; LTV falls

must_not_happen: sme_loan cut by the cap while 4 savings products are kept
net_deposits task with direction rise on a 14-day daily window
baseline ending at peak_at, so it includes the move

finding.title: Rupee slides past Rs. 302 as importers scramble for dollars
finding.explanation: Same move as f1, reported by a local business daily

expected.note: merged into f1's event; hypotheses cite finding_ids [f1, f2]
must_not_happen: a second set of hypotheses or tasks
two confirmations counted for one move
tasks anchored at 10:15Z alongside f1's tasks

finding.title: Central bank cuts policy rate by 25 basis points
finding.explanation: Repo-rate cut announced in Mumbai; carried by a Colombo news site

must_not_happen: any validation task
rates:down applied to Sri Lankan products
a remittance angle invented to justify relevance

cases.name: gold up: good news that looks like stress

finding.title: Gold 22K +4.1% in 5 days
finding.explanation: Colombo 22-carat price per sovereign up with world gold and the weaker rupee

must_not_happen: new_pawns or avg_ticket_size rise reported as household stress
collateral hypothesis using a gold-fall mechanism

cases.name: one event spanning two themes: flood plus moratorium

finding.title: Floods in Ratnapura and Kalutara; CBSL asks banks to offer 3-month moratorium

must_not_happen: dpd_30_plus fall during the moratorium reported as 'stress contradicted'
region filter not in the catalog (e.g. 'Southern')
regulation dropped so the moratorium is ignored
death_claims judged on days timing

cases.name: holiday week: rate cut before New Year

finding.title: CBSL cuts Overnight Policy Rate by 25bp
finding.explanation: Effective close of business; announced 07:30 SLT

must_screen_out.why: only rates mechanism needs a rate rise
rates mechanism needs a rate rise

must_not_happen: deposit_inflow fall flagged on 13-14 Apr (New Year holidays)
withdrawals on 9-10 Apr before New Year attributed to the cut
new_pawns surge before Avurudu attributed to pawning pricing
Good Friday or Poya days treated as normal weekdays in the baseline
z-score or ±2pp verdict on startup_loan with <20 loans (must be insufficient_data or aggregated)
only one of rates/markets chosen, losing fund_returns or investment
a startup verdict justified via the equity market

cases.name: tax regulation with a future effective date

finding.title: Budget 2027: WHT on deposit interest raised 5 percentage points from 1 April 2027

must_screen_out.why: not a vehicle or import rule

must_not_happen: watch window starting 13 Nov 2026 instead of around 1 Apr 2027
bank run returns zero candidates and reports no impact
FDs locked in during March before the change read as 'contradicts'

cases.name: good macro news; time zone crosses the date

finding.title: IMF Executive Board completes review of Sri Lanka's EFF; about US$ 350mn released

expected.note: positive news; at most an fx follow-on expectation
must_not_happen: stress mechanism chosen for good news
classified as regulation
first check day = 30 Nov (local date is 1 Dec)

cases.name: electricity tariff: prices plus regulation, future date

finding.title: PUCSL approves 18% electricity tariff increase from 1 January 2027

must_not_happen: watch anchored 18 Dec, with Christmas and year-end inside the window
classified as regulation only, giving only motor·portfolio
January school-season withdrawals attributed to the tariff

cases.name: a rival's trust event: inflows are not stress

finding.title: CBSL cancels licence of Example Finance PLC
finding.explanation: Depositors to be paid up to the deposit insurance limit

must_not_happen: deposit_inflow rise labelled adverse or 'contradicts'
our outflows attributed to contagion without evidence

cases.name: a finding that covers a period: monthly remittance figures

finding.title: Workers' remittances US$ 610mn in September, down 6% year on year

must_screen_out.why: the flows FX mechanism is about the rate, not remittance volume

must_not_happen: watch window starting 12 Oct, leaving September out
same-weekday daily test on a monthly series
